subject: jazz
title: Usage-feedback-calibrated token counter with measured request-overhead gap
one_why: Pre-call trigger stays an estimate (exact BPE only for OpenAI families) but every provider usage.promptTokens response retrains the per-model chars/token ratio AND measures request overhead as usage-minus-estimated-messages, closing the 10-30k MCP-schema blind spot that cline-style thresholds have; nuance vs pi: estimate-plus-correction rather than measured projection.

subject: jazz
title: Ephemeral pressure nudges deliberately excluded from the cache breakpoint
one_why: Context/budget/time/cost pressure messages ride the request uncached and the breakpoint walks back to the last persisted message, so per-turn changing guidance never spends the incremental cache write on content guaranteed to miss - tested at ai-sdk-service.test.ts:1979-1998; no other anchor treats nudging and cache-prefix stability as one design problem.

subject: jazz
title: Fail-closed LLM command-risk classifier gates execute_command
one_why: A cheap 16-token-classifier model labels read-only/low-risk/high-risk with 8s timeout, and timeouts, errors, and ambiguous replies all stay high-risk; classifier tokens are metered separately from loop totals (agent-run-metrics.ts) so approval gating is observable apart from the conversation.

subject: jazz
title: Per-conversation OS uid + JAZZ_HOME isolation for multi-user bot bridges
one_why: One bridge process serves many strangers; instead of filename-prefix isolation (which every tool call steps past) each conversation gets its own uid and setgid-stamped home so the kernel enforces the split - honest about the ceiling: engages only when the bridge runs as root, degrades to shared dir elsewhere.

subject: jazz
title: Full A/B eval harness never invoked by any CI workflow
one_why: evals/ has tasks, judge, held-model A/B, and memory-judgment calibration (evals/README.md) but zero of the seven workflows reference evals and the only cron builds a plugin catalog (community-plugin-catalog.yml:6); per errata a cost-capped nightly live-eval job would break the verification-8 ceiling that jazz otherwise sits under.

subject: jazz
title: A2A server door on the existing trust model, tested against the official SDK's parser
one_why: A2A wire format (agent card, SendMessageResponse, PascalCase JSON-RPC) is validated by parsing with @a2a-js/sdk classes (a2a.test.ts:70) and authorization reuses jazz's own tier/persona/bearer-token model instead of a second trust system; deliberately minimal (one sync method, no task lifecycle) - the only A2A surface found across all studied subjects.

subject: jazz
title: Parking restricted to lone tool calls so resume replay is exactly-once
one_why: A run that parks for a human replays its stopped batch rather than re-entering the executor mid-batch; because parking is only allowed on a lone tool call, replay is exactly one tool running once with its approval already answered - durable RunRecord (run-record.ts:1-12) carries parked-turn snapshots that are dropped on resume.

subject: jazz
title: Four-rung overflow ladder with config-enforced ordering (trim above compact above warn above clear)
one_why: Clear 0.5 / warn 0.7 / compact 0.8 / trim 0.95 with the ordering as a validated property: config resolution rejects a compact ratio at-or-above trim and warn at-or-above compact (context-thresholds.test.ts:36-49), so a user misconfiguration can never silently collapse the ladder into a sliding window.
